posts.author: pluto
posts.content_md: Just a warning about those cheap Chinese 18650 batteries and chargers. 18650 batteries can have quite low internal resistance (as some are designed for high current draw) and can vent or blow up if either the battery or charger are defective. It might be unlikely but still worth being cautious.
